records.found: On 2026-11-05 Intellia reported it had finished enrolling its late-stage nerve-disease trial (MAGNITUDE-2, more than the 60 patients aimed for), had moved on enrolment in the heart trial, and had begun giving doctors patients' immune-gene (HLA) results; the registry shows both trials updated on 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05. The same release repeats that a regulator decision on the company's hereditary angioedema editor (a different disease) is due 2027-03-10.

findings.what: Intellia third-quarter release (filed copy on sec.gov): MAGNITUDE-2 enrolment complete in hereditary transthyretin polyneuropathy; MAGNITUDE (heart) enrolment advancing; HLA genotyping results being given to investigators; no new safety event stated; lonvo-z (hereditary angioedema) decision date 2027-03-10.
Registry entry for the nerve-disease late-stage trial now reads active, not recruiting, last updated 2026-11-05; estimated primary completion 2027-07.
Registry entry for the heart trial (MAGNITUDE) still recruiting, last updated 2026-11-04; estimated primary completion 2027-12; no results.

Nature paper on a one-time base editor for ANGPTL3 (a blood-fat gene) given into the body: monkeys, over 90 percent fall in the protein for 3 years, and a first-in-human trial is said to be under way. Not an age-related disease and no human result in the paper.

unmatched.what: Intellia reports the FDA accepted its application for lonvo-z (hereditary angioedema), the first in-body CRISPR therapy to reach that stage, with a decision due 2027-03-10 (acceptance itself announced in September).
